environment: A disposable localhost-only HTML Notification API probe on 127.0.0.1:18799, inspected through Chrome and the Codex in-app browser. No production account, DM, credential or message was used.

checks.name: browser_api_capability
checks.detail: Both browser tabs displayed secure=true, Notification API=function, permission=default, navigator.locks=true and localStorage=true. This is an API availability observation, not proof of notification delivery.

checks.name: permission_request
checks.detail: Clicking the probe's explicit Request notification permission button left both tab accessibility trees and screenshots at permission=default with no action result or visible permission prompt. The permission request did not resolve in the observed page state. No permission was granted.

checks.name: chrome_site_permission_settings
checks.detail: Browser Use rejected navigation to the localhost site-permission settings with a browser URL policy block and explicitly prohibited workaround, alternate browser surfaces and policy circumvention. No settings were changed.

checks.name: focused_frontend_tests
checks.detail: Four files, 14 tests passed at the current source commit. These use a fake Notification runtime and do not verify a browser permission prompt or OS notification.

checks.name: two_recipient_tabs_and_nonparticipant_os_delivery
checks.detail: Without granted permission, hidden-tab OS delivery, generic preview, cross-tab deduplication and silence for a third nonparticipant were not observed. Earlier private-WebSocket evidence remains separate.

checks.name: fixture_cleanup
checks.detail: Temporary browser tabs closed; localhost server stopped; exact probe file and directory removed; port 18799 has no listener.

remaining_condition: On an approved browser/test origin, grant Notification permission through visible browser UI; use a fixed trusted Vue bundle, two isolated authenticated recipient tabs and one third nonparticipant, then observe exactly one generic hidden-tab OS notification for an addressed DM, none for the third account, deduplication and silence after permission revocation.
